concepts_present.evidence_quote: We view object detection as a direct set prediction problem.
DETR uses a transformer encoder-decoder architecture on top of a convolutional backbone.
We use ResNet-50 and ResNet-101 as backbones.
Set prediction loss combines the classification loss and the box loss.
Box loss combines L1 and the generalized IoU loss.

concepts_absent.rationale: DETR explicitly removes the region-proposal stage.
Although DETR has no anchors, it is not described as anchor-free in the FCOS / CornerNet sense; it uses learned object queries.
DETR removes NMS via bipartite matching.
No ROI extraction; queries attend directly to features.
Base DETR is detection-only (mask version is panoptic-DETR, separate).
DETR is end-to-end single-pass; not two-stage.
DETR has no proposal stage; Selective Search is irrelevant to its end-to-end transformer pipeline.
DETR is a transformer-based detector; DPM is a pre-deep-learning method.
